newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Short-term interest rates on Zimbabwe's liquid money market were quoted mixed in Wednesday trade, dealers said.
The market opened with a Z$10.5 million surplus which was boosted by maturity of some Z$700 million worth of bills.

To mop up some of the excess money the central Reserve Bank auctioned Z$600 million 91-day treasury bills to discount houses at 24.61 percent, slightly down from 24.69 percent at the last similar auction on Friday.
NCDs maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought on the secondary market 26.25 percent from 26.5 percent and sold at 26 percent from a 25 to 25.5 percentage range.
Bankers' acceptance bills were quoted unchanged at 25.25 percent (buying) but edged up to 25 from 24.55 percent on the selling side while call money slipped to 22.5 from 23.5 percent.
